docs.summary: Convenience helper that bin-packs a list of mesh instances across one or more [`LightmapTarget`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.LightmapTarget)s. Each mesh's atlas footprint is sized from its world-space surface area times the `texelsPerWorldUnit` density squared (so larger surfaces get more lightmap resolution), then shelf-packed into atlases: when the current atlas runs out of room, a new one is created.
docs.remarks: This sits on top of the imperative API: it ultimately just calls [`CreateTextureTarget`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.LightmapBaker~CreateTextureTarget) and [`AddBakeInstance`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.LightmapTarget~AddBakeInstance) for you. If you want finer control over which instance lives in which atlas, you can keep using the imperative methods directly.

members.name: Pack
members.signature: public static AutoAtlasResult Pack(LightmapBaker baker, System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<(BakeMesh mesh, Float4x4 transform)> meshes, int atlasWidth, int atlasHeight, float texelsPerWorldUnit = 50f, int padding = 2, string bakeUVLayer = "UV1")

docs.summary: Pack the given meshes into N atlas pages. Returns the targets that were created (in creation order: index 0 is the first atlas, etc.), and a parallel array mapping each input mesh to the [`BakeInstance`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.BakeInstance) that was added for it.

params.baker: The baker that should own the new targets and instances.
params.meshes: Mesh + world-transform pairs to pack. Each mesh must have a UV layer named `bakeUVLayer` with coords in `[0, 1]^2` (i.e. each mesh's UV1 fills its own atlas region, not all of UV space).
params.texelsPerWorldUnit: Target lightmap density. 50 = each metre of world surface gets ~50 texels along its largest dimension; bump it up for higher quality.
params.padding: Pixels of padding between every placement.
params.bakeUVLayer: Name of the UV layer to use as the bake layer.

members.name: PackFixed
members.signature: public static AutoAtlasResult PackFixed(LightmapBaker baker, System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<(BakeMesh mesh, Float4x4 transform, int atlasIndex, Float2 uvOffset, Float2 uvScale)> items, int atlasWidth, int atlasHeight, string bakeUVLayer = "UV1")

docs.summary: "Lock atlas": recreate targets and instances from **previously-computed** placements (atlas index + UV offset/scale per mesh) instead of repacking. Use this on a re-bake so each renderer keeps the exact same atlas region — its lightmap index and scale/offset stay stable, which matters when those values were already persisted on the renderers/scene.

params.baker: The baker that should own the new targets and instances.
params.items: Per-mesh placement: mesh, world transform, target/atlas index, and the UV offset/scale into that atlas (as produced by a prior [`Pack`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.AutoAtlasPacker~Pack) / [`UVOffset`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.BakeInstance~UVOffset) + [`UVScale`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.BakeInstance~UVScale)).
params.atlasWidth: Page width in pixels (must match the original bake).
params.atlasHeight: Page height in pixels (must match the original bake).
params.bakeUVLayer: Name of the UV layer to use as the bake layer.
